notes.title: North Africa reference quality boundary
notes.text: The source’s ethnic-origin line, city ranking, military-causation wording, port ranking, and country-area superlative are excluded. Libya and Tunisia political material is retained only with explicit historic scope.

notes.title: Sudan and South Sudan quality boundary
notes.text: Conflict labels, militia/rebel details, recognition order, newest-country language, disputed-territory wording, and generalized African-independence counts are withheld. Approved records are bounded historic or geographic references.

notes.title: Africa country reference quality boundary
notes.text: The Sierra Leone Bangla state-language claim is rejected. Superlatives, security framing, ethnic labels, colonial simplifications, and discovery claims are excluded rather than presented as neutral facts.

notes.title: Island-state reference quality boundary
notes.text: Tourism rankings, sporting nicknames, current-administration claims, mineral-resource callout language, and unexplained country-name assertions are excluded. Only bounded geography and historical references are retained.

notes.title: Africa MCQ source-key boundary
notes.text: All accepted questions have readable stems, four source-visible options, and a visually confirmed printed key. The ambiguous Gaddafi-square item, false Sierra Leone Bangla-language item, and time-sensitive population-ranking item are withheld.
